players.product: Power Systems division: backup engines and gas engines for prime power at data centres; next-generation engine to replace the Series 4000, targeting the data centre market with increased power density (launch 2028)

quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce Achieves U.S. Navy Certification for its mtu (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rolls-Royce's mtu Series 4000 and Series 2000 marine engines received U.S. Navy certification for autonomous naval vessel operations: after two 720-hour durability tests the Series 4000 is certified for autonomous use at up to 4,300 kW of propulsion power and 3,000 kWe of power generation (V8, V12, V16 and V20), and the Series 2000 for propulsion up to 1,939 kW (V10, V12 and V16). Successful testing qualifies propulsion systems to power an unmanned ship for 30-day deployments at sea without maintenance; the Navy's Sea Hunter unmanned surface vessel is powered by twin mtu 12V 2000 engines.
quarterly_data.figure: Series 4000 up to 4,300 kW / 3,000 kWe; Series 2000 up to 1,939 kW
